title: Standard Form (Scientific Notation)
seo_title: Standard Form – JSS 2 Mathematics Worksheets with Answers (NERDC)
standard_text: Write large and small numbers in standard form (A × 10ⁿ); change numbers from standard form to ordinary form; order and calculate with numbers in standard form. (summary of the NERDC JSS 2 Mathematics curriculum)
meta_desc: Free JSS 2 maths worksheets on standard form: writing large and small numbers as A × 10ⁿ, ordinary numbers, ordering and multiplying and dividing in standard form. 100 questions with answers.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • A number in standard form is A × 10ⁿ where 1 ≤ A < 10 and n is a whole number.
  • Large numbers: count how many places the point moves left: 45,000 = 4.5 × 10⁴.
  • Small numbers: the point moves right and the power is negative: 0.0032 = 3.2 × 10⁻³.

Examples

Example

Write 6,800,000

Point moves 6 places

Answer: 6.8 × 10⁶

Example

(3 × 10⁴) × (2 × 10³)

6 × 10⁷

Answer: 6 × 10⁷

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Writing 45 × 10³A must be between 1 and 10: 4.5 × 10⁴.
Using a positive power for small numbers0.004 = 4 × 10⁻³.
Adding the A values when multiplyingMultiply the A values and add the powers.

faq.a: To write very big or very small numbers neatly.
In science: the distance to the sun, the size of cells.

items.q: Work out (9.5 × 105) × (6 × 106). Give your answer in standard form.
items.e: Multiply the front numbers: 9.5 × 6 = 57. Add the powers: 5 + 6 = 11. 57 is not between 1 and 10, so adjust: 5.7 × 1012.

items.q: Work out (4 × 101) × (8 × 10−3). Give your answer in standard form.
items.e: Multiply the front numbers: 4 × 8 = 32. Add the powers: 1 + (−3) = −2. 32 is not between 1 and 10, so adjust: 3.2 × 10−1.

items.q: Work out (2.2 × 100) × (2 × 103). Give your answer in standard form.
items.e: Multiply the front numbers: 2.2 × 2 = 4.4. Add the powers: 0 + 3 = 3. 4.4 × 103.

items.q: Work out (4 × 103) ÷ (4 × 10−3). Give your answer in standard form.
items.e: Divide the front numbers: 4 ÷ 4 = 1. Subtract the powers: 3 − (−3) = 6. 1 × 106.

items.q: Work out (4.375 × 105) ÷ (2.5 × 10−2). Give your answer in standard form.
items.e: Divide the front numbers: 4.375 ÷ 2.5 = 1.75. Subtract the powers: 5 − (−2) = 7. 1.75 × 107.

items.q: Work out (4 × 10−1) × (1 × 106). Give your answer in standard form.
items.e: Multiply the front numbers: 4 × 1 = 4. Add the powers: −1 + 6 = 5. 4 × 105.

items.q: Work out (2.8 × 104) × (2 × 10−1). Give your answer in standard form.
items.e: Multiply the front numbers: 2.8 × 2 = 5.6. Add the powers: 4 + (−1) = 3. 5.6 × 103.

items.q: Work out (7 × 102) × (1 × 104). Give your answer in standard form.
items.e: Multiply the front numbers: 7 × 1 = 7. Add the powers: 2 + 4 = 6. 7 × 106.

items.q: Work out (7 × 105) × (7 × 10−3). Give your answer in standard form.
items.e: Multiply the front numbers: 7 × 7 = 49. Add the powers: 5 + (−3) = 2. 49 is not between 1 and 10, so adjust: 4.9 × 103.

items.q: Work out (3 × 10−1) ÷ (2 × 10−4). Give your answer in standard form.
items.e: Divide the front numbers: 3 ÷ 2 = 1.5. Subtract the powers: −1 − (−4) = 3. 1.5 × 103.

items.q: Work out (6 × 107) ÷ (2 × 10−1). Give your answer in standard form.
items.e: Divide the front numbers: 6 ÷ 2 = 3. Subtract the powers: 7 − (−1) = 8. 3 × 108.

items.q: Work out (7.5 × 101) × (1 × 10−3). Give your answer in standard form.
items.e: Multiply the front numbers: 7.5 × 1 = 7.5. Add the powers: 1 + (−3) = −2. 7.5 × 10−2.

items.q: Work out (6 × 108) × (7 × 100). Give your answer in standard form.
items.e: Multiply the front numbers: 6 × 7 = 42. Add the powers: 8 + 0 = 8. 42 is not between 1 and 10, so adjust: 4.2 × 109.

items.q: Work out (7 × 10−4) × (4 × 10−3). Give your answer in standard form.
items.e: Multiply the front numbers: 7 × 4 = 28. Add the powers: −4 + (−3) = −7. 28 is not between 1 and 10, so adjust: 2.8 × 10−6.

items.q: Work out (6 × 102) ÷ (4 × 106). Give your answer in standard form.
items.e: Divide the front numbers: 6 ÷ 4 = 1.5. Subtract the powers: 2 − 6 = −4. 1.5 × 10−4.

items.q: Work out (2.5 × 103) ÷ (2.5 × 104). Give your answer in standard form.
items.e: Divide the front numbers: 2.5 ÷ 2.5 = 1. Subtract the powers: 3 − 4 = −1. 1 × 10−1.

items.q: Work out (1.1 × 103) × (7 × 10−4). Give your answer in standard form.
items.e: Multiply the front numbers: 1.1 × 7 = 7.7. Add the powers: 3 + (−4) = −1. 7.7 × 10−1.

items.q: Work out (6 × 10−3) × (9 × 103). Give your answer in standard form.
items.e: Multiply the front numbers: 6 × 9 = 54. Add the powers: −3 + 3 = 0. 54 is not between 1 and 10, so adjust: 5.4 × 101.

items.q: Work out (8.75 × 10−1) ÷ (5 × 105). Give your answer in standard form.
items.e: Divide the front numbers: 8.75 ÷ 5 = 1.75. Subtract the powers: −1 − 5 = −6. 1.75 × 10−6.

items.q: Work out (8.4 × 104) × (7 × 102). Give your answer in standard form.
items.e: Multiply the front numbers: 8.4 × 7 = 58.8. Add the powers: 4 + 2 = 6. 58.8 is not between 1 and 10, so adjust: 5.88 × 107.
